## Goal

Download SRA runs for the Chelonia mydas embryo dataset, convert the downloaded data to compressed FASTQ files, and prepare reads using fastp.

## Working environment and locations

- Log into HPC: `emhamp@bora.sciclone.wm.edu`.
- Project directory: `~/scr10/Biol504L/project`.
- Activate conda environment: `module load miniforge3/24.9.2-0`
                              `conda activate sra_prep`

## Download SRA runs

I edited `sra_download.sh` and submitted it using `sbatch`. The saved version shown below downloads five accessions using `prefetch`.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=sra_fetch3
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH -t 4:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=8G

for seqrun in SRR18173240 SRR18173239 SRR18173238 SRR18173237 SRR18173236
do
 prefetch -v $seqrun
done
```

## Convert SRA data to compressed FASTQ

I copied and edited `sra_fastq_dump.sh`, changing the accession and output directory between submissions. 

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=ehjob
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=8
#SBATCH -t 4:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=8G

parallel-fastq-dump --split-files \
     --gzip \
     --threads 8 \
     -s SRR18173236 \
     -O Cmydas_embryo_SRR18173236
```

## Filter and trim reads with fastp

I created `sra_fastq_trim.sh` by copying `sra_fastq_dump.sh`, then replaced the conversion command with a fastp command.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=ehjob
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=8
#SBATCH -t 4:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=8G

fastp \
     -i Cmydas_embryo_SRR18173246/SRR18173246_1.fastq.gz \
     -o Cmydas_embryo_SRR18173246.Fwd.20q.70nt.fastq.gz \
     -h Cmydas_embryo_SRR18173246.html \
     -R "Cmydas_embryo_SRR18173246 Report" \
     -q 20 \
     -l 70 \
     -w 8 \
     -r
```

Settings in the command:

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-i` | Input FASTQ file |
| `-o` | Filtered/trimmed FASTQ output |
| `-h` | HTML report filename |
| `-R` | Report title |
| `-q 20` | Phred threshold for classifying a base as qualified during quality filtering |
| `-l 70` | Discard reads shorter than 70 bases after processing |
| `-w 8` | Use eight worker threads |
| `-r` | Enable sliding-window quality cutting toward the right end |


## Troubleshooting

I submitted jobs and monitored them with commands such as:

```bash
sbatch sra_fastq_trim.sh
squeue -u emhamp
sacct -j 594408
cat slurm-594383.out
```
